description: This PHP script handles file uploads for email templates, specifically validating image types, moving uploaded files to cache directories, and returning the file paths as JSON. It also includes license headers and initial environment checks.

classes.name: UploadFile
classes.description: A class responsible for managing file uploads, including validation and moving of uploaded files.

methods.name: confirm_upload
methods.description: Validates whether the upload process was successful.

methods.name: get_stored_file_name
methods.description: Returns the name under which the uploaded file is stored.

methods.name: final_move
methods.description: Moves the uploaded file to its final destination.

methods.name: get_upload_path
methods.description: Returns the upload path for a given file GUID.
